objective: Apply the Desktop AVATARS category quota to both hashed member-avatar files and the extensionless legacy member_profile_avatars directory while preserving offline reads.

implementation.sharedCache: The media-cache-v1/avatars/member-assets directory and cacheDir/member_profile_avatars share the current AVATARS allocation.
implementation.legacyNaming: Legacy names continue to use the sanitized cache key without an extension; invalid path segments and names longer than 200 characters are rejected.
implementation.eviction: Recognized regular files across both directories use one LRU byte/file budget; read-triggered cleanup is rate-limited by the shared cache manager.
implementation.migration: A valid legacy avatar is copied to the hashed cache and verified before its extensionless source file is removed.
implementation.readOnlyBehavior: Existing hashed and legacy files remain available when new writes are blocked, including when the dynamic category quota is zero.
scopeLimits: This is Desktop-only; no Android APK was changed or built.
No physical PC interaction or sustained performance measurement was performed.
The MSI is a local validation artifact and was not published.
